author: DeLaMonkey
quote: I really wanted to like this game, but it's one of the biggest letdowns I've ever played. The story is awful. Jason and Lucia are boring and have no chemistry at all. Everyone keeps calling it a mature love story, but it's just two people having the same mopey conversation over and over for 40 hours. Neither of them has any real personality. Jason is completely flat and Lucia gets one trait that the game keeps hammering on start to finish. The dialogue tries way too hard to sound deep. Nothing interesting happens for huge stretches, there are no real stakes, and by the end I didn't care what happened to either of them. You're just relieved it's over. The satire that made GTA what it is is basically gone too. The older games were funny and actually had something to say. This one takes itself way too seriously and has nothing to say at all. There's also barely any action. Most of your time goes on driving somewhere, talking to someone, then driving somewhere else, over and over. It's a chore simulator. I kept waiting for it to pick up and it never did. The map is detailed and looks great, but that doesn't matter when there's nothing fun to do in it. Honestly it plays like a Ubisoft game. Strip the Rockstar name off and you've got a Far Cry game, a big pretty open world, a story that thinks it's deeper than it is, and a pile of filler to pad out the runtime. Far Cry is trash, and Rockstar spent 13 years and who knows how much money making their own version of it. The graphics are the only thing it really has going for it. Everything else is boring and slow, and the story is a massive letdown. I don't get the perfect scores at all, and I think a lot of people are just hyping it up because they waited so long. Do not let a single person in that building touch the development of Online, that's the only way this dumpster fire will end. And the coping will end they're just in denial for now.
